answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with unpredictable liveness challenges: every identity must answer a fresh, time-boxed puzzle within minutes, like a ridge guard demanding a new password at each crossing. A single honest agent answers easily, but a farm of a thousand fakes must solve a thousand puzzles at once — the ocean of cheap identities evaporates when each one needs live attention. A jade token of liveness cannot be stockpiled in advance, so the attacker's cost scales with every fake they run.
